lyrics.ja: 前略 電子の海は今日も
lyrics.romaji: Zenryaku Denshi no Umi ha Kyou mo
lyrics.en: A quick note—the digital sea today is again
lyrics.zh: 前略，電子之海今天也是

lyrics.ja: 晴れ 時々雪 ところによりパフェ
lyrics.romaji: Hare Tokidoki Yuki Tokoro ni Yori Pafe
lyrics.en: Sunny, sometimes snowy, with a chance of parfait
lyrics.zh: 晴天，偶爾下雪，局部地區有聖代

lyrics.ja: 前人未踏のテラバイ島で
lyrics.romaji: Zenjin Mitou no Terabai Tou de
lyrics.en: On the unexplored terabyte island
lyrics.zh: 在無人踏足的兆位元組島上

lyrics.ja: またどこかのあなたを 待機中
lyrics.romaji: Mata Dokoka no Anata wo Taikichuu
lyrics.en: Waiting again for you, somewhere out there
lyrics.zh: 再次等待著不知在何處的你

lyrics.ja: 偶然だって必然のうち
lyrics.en: Even coincidence is part of inevitability
lyrics.zh: 偶然也是必然的一部分

lyrics.ja: 受信送信は見えない糸でしょ
lyrics.romaji: Jushin Soushin ha Mienai Ito Desho
lyrics.en: Receiving and sending are invisible threads, right?
lyrics.zh: 收訊與傳訊就像看不見的線對吧

lyrics.ja: 断然こっちがしっくりくる
lyrics.en: This side definitely feels just right

lyrics.ja: Enter space で escape
lyrics.en: Enter space and escape

lyrics.ja: (The boom) ここは0と1の楽園
lyrics.romaji: (The Boom) Koko ha Zero to Ichi no Rakuen
lyrics.en: (The boom) This is a paradise of zeroes and ones

lyrics.ja: (The boom) 広く深い世界から見つけだして
lyrics.romaji: (The Boom) Hiroku Fukai Sekai kara Mitsukedashite
lyrics.en: (The boom) Find me from this vast, deep world
lyrics.zh: （The boom）從寬廣深邃的世界中找到我

lyrics.ja: エレクトリカル サーフィン サーフィン
lyrics.en: Electrical surfing, surfing

lyrics.ja: こちらに来て来て
lyrics.en: Come here, come, come

lyrics.ja: 好いも狂いもいただきます
lyrics.en: I'll savor both the good and the mad
lyrics.zh: 美好的與瘋狂的，我全都收下

lyrics.ja: サーフィン サーフィン
lyrics.en: Surfing, surfing

lyrics.ja: 手と手とってって
lyrics.en: Take my hand, take it

lyrics.ja: 白昼夢中 夢中で踊り明かしましょう
lyrics.romaji: Hakuchuu Muchuu Muchuu de Odori Akashimashou
lyrics.en: In broad daylight, let's dance the night away in a daze
lyrics.zh: 大白天地，忘我地跳舞到天明吧

lyrics.ja: 攻略!電子の海は今日も
lyrics.romaji: Kouryaku! Denshi no Umi ha Kyou mo
lyrics.en: Strategy guide! The digital sea today is again
lyrics.zh: 攻略！電子之海今天也是

lyrics.ja: 赤 青 緑でとにかくいっぱいいっぱい
lyrics.romaji: Aka Ao Midori de Tonikaku Ippai Ippai
lyrics.en: Red, blue, green—anyway, full to the brim

lyrics.ja: 悠々自適のテラバイ島で
lyrics.romaji: Yuuyuu Jiteki no Terabai Tou de
lyrics.en: On the leisurely terabyte island
lyrics.zh: 在悠閒自在的兆位元組島上

lyrics.ja: お待ちかねのいつもの 開始中（えい）
lyrics.en: The usual you've been waiting for is now starting (hey)
lyrics.zh: 久等的慣例活動，開始中（嘿）

lyrics.ja: そんなこんなどんなもんなあんなようなこと
lyrics.romaji: Sonna Konna Donna Mon na Anna You na Koto
lyrics.en: This kind, that kind, whatever kind, that kind of thing
lyrics.zh: 這樣那樣、各種各樣、諸如此類的事

lyrics.ja: くだらなさこそが至福の時でしょ
lyrics.romaji: Kudaranasa Koso ga Shifuku no Toki Desho
lyrics.en: It's the silliness itself that's the blissful time, right?
lyrics.zh: 正是無聊瑣事才是至福時光對吧

lyrics.ja: のんびりでぐーたらであーだこーだでいこう
lyrics.romaji: Nonbiri de Guutara de Aa da Koo da de Ikou
lyrics.en: Let's go slowly, lazily, chatting about this and that
lyrics.zh: 悠哉懶散地，東扯西扯地前進吧

lyrics.ja: Command delete で respawn
lyrics.en: Command delete and respawn

lyrics.ja: (The boom) ここは雲の向こうの未来
lyrics.romaji: (The Boom) Koko ha Kumo no Mukou no Mirai
lyrics.en: (The boom) This is the future beyond the clouds
lyrics.zh: （The boom）這裡是雲端彼方的未來

lyrics.ja: (The boom) 狭く暗いブラウザじゃ物足りないの
lyrics.romaji: (The Boom) Semaku Kurai Burauza ja Monotarinai no
lyrics.en: (The boom) A narrow, dark browser isn't enough
lyrics.zh: （The boom）狹窄陰暗的瀏覽器無法滿足
